rundown: Devils beat Blue Jackets 3-2 at Prudential Center in Newark, NJ. Devils led 3-2 after two periods and held on.
5 goals in all. Devils's last: Connor Brown Goal Snap Shot, assists: Dougie Hamilton (9), Jonas Siegenthaler (5), 2nd period 14:41.
Leading the way — Blue Jackets: Charlie Coyle 1 goal, 1 pts; Damon Severson 1 ast. Devils: Connor Brown 1 goal, 1 ast, 2 pts.
Where Devils won it: they outshot them 30-21 and out-hit them 17-15.
Against the closing line (DraftKings): Devils closed as 1.5-goal favorites and won but didn't cover (Blue Jackets +1.5 cashed); the total closed at 6.5 and they combined for 5, under by 1.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 23, 6:54 PM ET. It had Blue Jackets 40% and Devils 60%, projecting Blue Jackets 2.8 – Devils 3.4 (6.1 total, Devils by 0.6).

Final: Blue Jackets 2 – Devils 3. Right winner: it had Devils at 60%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Blue Jackets came in with a 6% below average attack and a league-average defense (9-12-0, 2.6 scored and 3.2 allowed a game over 21 games), worth about 79 and 79 games of evidence. Projected to score 2.8, they scored 2 (−0.8 goals, 28% under); projected to allow 3.4, they allowed 3 (−0.4 goals, 11% under).

Devils came in with a 3% above average attack and a league-average defense (15-8-0, 3.8 scored and 3.2 allowed a game over 23 games), worth about 81 and 81 games of evidence. Projected to score 3.4, they scored 3 (−0.4 goals, 11% under); projected to allow 2.8, they allowed 2 (−0.8 goals, 28% under).

The bigger miss was Blue Jackets' scoring (-0.8 goals against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 5 against 6.1 projected (-1.1), about the 32nd percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±2.5).

Margin: Devils by 1 against Devils by 0.6 projected, about the 57th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±2.5).

An ordinary result: inside the range the simulations expected most of the time.

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body:
NJ ML (-205) at -205: the algo gave it 64% vs 64% fair (-0.4 pts) — won (+0.5u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 64%). CBJ ML (+170) at +170: the algo gave it 36% vs 36% fair (+0.4 pts) — lost (-1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 36%). NJ -1.5 (+124) at +124: the algo gave it 42% vs 43% fair (-0.8 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. CBJ +1.5 (-148) at -148: the algo gave it 58% vs 57% fair (+0.8 pts) — won (+0.7u); same number as the close. OVER 6.5 (+100) at +100: the algo gave it 47% vs 48% fair (-0.4 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. UNDER 6.5 (-120) at -120: the algo gave it 53% vs 52% fair (+0.4 pts) — won (+0.8u); same number as the close.

The line barely moved between the algo's snapshot and the close.

No bet: nothing cleared the algo's bar before the game.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body: Splits (Action Network): spread: 9% of bets on Blue Jackets, 4% of the money — Blue Jackets covered; total: 51% of bets on the over, 88% of the money — it went under; moneyline: 6% of bets on Blue Jackets, 1% of the money.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.798 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by +0.2 goals. It counts toward NHL scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 133 graded NHL games the algo now scales scoring ×0.959 and gives home teams -0.2 goals. Team corrections so far: Blue Jackets attack ×0.960, defense ×1.012 (9 games); Devils attack ×1.040, defense ×0.982 (9 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total within its normal range, margin within its normal range, no bet.
